Check object properties, move object to desired location and perform task. Otherwise, scan the area for the object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesiredLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGrabbable    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />
